lots.what_it_is: Mixed box of LPs led by The Beatles Box 'From Liverpool' (1980 EMI World Records mail-order 8 LP set, SM701-708, wooden-crate style box). All 8 numbered picture sleeves shown, no discs shown. Balance is common 1970s-80s LPs (Dire Straits Alchemy, Rocky Horror, Men at Work Cargo, Dylan Desire, Leonard Cohen, Kris and Rita, Emmylou Harris, Gordon Lightfoot, Joan Armatrading, a Various compilation).
lots.key_photo_findings: Box title 'From Liverpool / The Beatles Box' read clearly in photos 1 and 2. Sleeves 1 to 8 all present and numbered. Box corners and edges worn, lid scuffed and split at corners; sleeves creased and edge-worn. No vinyl visible anywhere, so disc presence, count and grading are unknown. Other LPs look played-copy ordinary.
lots.condition: Box fair (worn, edge splits); sleeves fair to good; discs unseen.

lots.what_it_is: Seven unframed Japanese woodblock prints after Hiroshige, plus one matted print: Tokaido designs (Hakone, Shono driving rain, Kameyama in snow), a snowy shrine gate, a rainy bridge with Fuji, a pagoda and temple view, and a matted Nihonbashi Clearing after Snow from One Hundred Famous Views of Edo. Very likely 20th century reprints.
lots.key_photo_findings: Hakone print shows title cartouche 'Tokaido gojusan tsugi no uchi, Hakone, Kosui zu' and 'Hiroshige ga' signature (photo 4). Shono and Kameyama also carry Hoeido-style cartouches. Enlarged photo 1: sheets have wide toned margins, creases and ragged edges, several narrow landscape-format sheets; colour flat and even. No publisher or reprint seal could be read at this resolution. Nihonbashi matted sheet looks bright and crisp, consistent with a modern reprint.
lots.condition: Toned paper, creases, edge wear and ragged margins; matted Nihonbashi appears clean.
